clauses.text:
Section 6 of Executive Order No. 11828 entitled Establishing a Com­
mission on CIA Activities Within the United States, dated January 4, 
1975 is amended by deleting the words “three months from the date of 
this order,” and substituting therefor “June 6, 1975.”
* ? .
T h e W h ite H ouse ,
March 29, 1975.
